newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot LPGs steady, but butane seen weakening.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot LPGs steady, but butane seen weakening.

text.p: Spot prices of Canada liquids were unchanged Thursday from those seen late last week, although some traders predicted normal butane would be pegged lower next week in sympathy with lower U.S. prices.
Sarnia propane remained on offer at 39.0 cents a gallon, players said, holding its own despite waning of the heating season. "It's mostly contract deals; not much spot stuff," one trader said.
Edmonton propane was also steady, with offers at 30.0 cents a gallon, traders said, as posted prices held firm with last week.
Field butane was unchanged in Sarnia at 42.0 cents and Edmonton normal butane held pat at 31.0 cents, traders said.

"But normal butane will come down pretty significantly starting next week," one Edmonton player said, predicting new posted prices will be adjusted downward in line with a two-cent drop in Mont Belvieu, Texas, prices in recent weeks.
